name: catalog_lot
description: GH #3593 / REQ-647, owner decisions D-065, D-066 and D-067. A lot (batch) master: one batch of one catalog_item. item_id is the record id of a catalog_item and a real foreign key (fk_catalog_lot_item_id, ON DELETE RESTRICT, D-066). code is the lot number, unique per item (D-065). producer is free text, not a reference to catalog_counterparty (D-065). mark is free text too (a UAT assumption, to be confirmed by the process owner). expiry_date is optional (D-065). active false retires the record, there is no delete operation. external_ref_system and external_ref_id are the nullable import key (0057 D1). The unique index over item_id and code leads with item_id and serves reads by item, so there is no separate indexes entry.
